crossRefs.note: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go…
Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.
When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our…
But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

people.name: Macedonia
people.line: A region in northern Greece; Paul preached there

translations.web: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
translations.bsb: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and to return to you from Macedonia, and then to have you help me on my way to Judea.
translations.kjv: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
translations.asv: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come unto you, and of you to be set forward on my journey unto Judaea.
